description: This file defines enums, structs, and functions related to handling different versions of the QUIC protocol, including version parsing, validation, and support checks.

classes.name: ParsedQuicVersion
classes.description: Represents a specific QUIC version including handshake protocol and transport version, with validation and utility methods.

methods.name: QuicVersionToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicTransportVersion enum to its string representation.

methods.name: HandshakeProtocolToString
methods.description: Converts a HandshakeProtocol enum to its string representation.

methods.name: QuicVersionUsesCryptoFrames
methods.description: Checks if a given transport version uses crypto frames for handshake.

methods.name: ParsedQuicVersionIsValid
methods.description: Validates if a combination of handshake protocol and transport version is supported.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a ParsedQuicVersion or vector to an output stream.

methods.name: ParseQuicVersionLabel
methods.description: Converts a version label to a ParsedQuicVersion.

methods.name: CreateQuicVersionLabel
methods.description: Creates a version label from a ParsedQuicVersion.

methods.name: QuicVersionLabelToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicVersionLabel to its string representation.

methods.name: ParseQuicVersionString
methods.description: Parses a version string like 'Q043' or 'h3-29' into a ParsedQuicVersion.

methods.name: SupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: AllSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns all supported QUIC versions, including disabled ones.

methods.name: CurrentSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns currently enabled supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: QuicVersionIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific version is currently enabled.
